$Comment: The ultimate's freeze (2026-10-21: the ultimate freezes everything, even his ice creatures, but hurts no ice creature; his other ice attacks still never freeze them). Copy of AT_Ice_King_Freeze (same ice block, shell, screen overlay, movement and ability locks) WITHOUT the Immunity_Freeze apply condition, so it also lands on the Gunters, snowmen and the king's other ice allies, which carry vanilla Immunity_Freeze (role CombatConfig EntityEffects) and are skipped by every normal freeze. The warmth potion still stops it. Only used by AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Mob_Tick/_Final (the beam on non-players); players get the normal freeze from the frost stacks and the last tick. If AT_Ice_King_Freeze changes, copy it again and drop the Immunity_Freeze condition.
